title: Liquid AI releases a 24B model for private on-device agents
friendlyTitle: Liquid AI made a model for private agents on your own hardware
summary: Liquid AI’s LFM2.5-24B-A2B is a 24-billion-parameter mixture model that activates about 2 billion parameters per token. It is designed for local reasoning, tool use and multi-step agent work in popular agent harnesses, with weights and deployment material available through Hugging Face.
friendlySummary: LFM2.5-24B-A2B is built to reason, use tools and complete several steps while running locally. It uses only part of the full model for each token to reduce computing work.
whyItMatters: A model that runs useful agent workloads on owned hardware can keep sensitive prompts local and reduce recurring inference costs. Its practical value will depend on memory requirements, hardware-specific speed and whether its tool-use reliability holds up in the intended workflow.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Local AI can protect private data and lower online service costs. Check that it runs well on your hardware before depending on it.
